subject: general
question:
The base diameter of a closed cylinder is 24 ft and height is 9 ft. Find the total surface area of the cylinder. 

 (Use pi = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of closed cylinder = 2 × π × r(r + h)

Given: r = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 ft, h = 9 ft

TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 12 × (12 + 9)

TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 12 × 21 = 44 × 36

**∴ The correct answer is 1584 ft².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the base (d) = 24 ft

Radius of the base (r) = d ÷ 2 = 12 ft

Height of the cylinder (h) = 9 ft

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

**Calculations:**

⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 12 × (12 + 9)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 12 × 21

⇒ TSA = 44 × 12 × 3

⇒ TSA = 44 × 36

⇒ TSA = 1584

**∴ The correct answer is 1584 ft².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

The area of the side surface excluding the top and bottom circular bases. Formula: CSA = 2πrh.

Volume of a Cylinder

The total 3D space occupied by the cylinder. Calculated by multiplying the base area by the height. Formula: V = πr²h.

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

Includes the curved surface area (2πr²) plus the flat circular base area (πr²). Formula: TSA = 3πr².
